get.description: Returns the platforms of the account with their current state. Filter them by `projectId`.
Returns the name and description of the platform, its number of organizations, its storage quota per account and its account statistics per offer.

put.description: Updates the name or description of the platform. When set, `checksum` must match the current checksum of the platform, otherwise the update is rejected.

value.message: The object is in an undesired status
The checksum is invalid because the object has expired

get.description: Returns the email accounts of the platform with their current state. Filter them by `organizationId`, `organizationLabel`, `domainId`, `email` or `offer`.

value.message: Filtering by this offer is not yet possible

post.description: Creates an email account from its `email`, `password`, `offer` and `slotId`. The domain must be ready and the slot must match the offer. Creation is asynchronous: follow `resourceStatus` and `currentTasks`.

value.message: The account name contains one or more forbidden characters; it should match: {{.REGEX_EMAIL}}

The email address for your account is already used; check existing mailbox, alias, redirection, or mailing list name
The chosen slot is in an undesired status
The chosen slot for an account was already reserved by another request; please retry

delete.description: Deletes the email account. An account blocked for spam cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns the email address, offer, slot, quota usage, contact information and detailed status of the email account, with its ongoing tasks.

value.message: Multiple accounts were found with the requested ID

put.description: Updates the email address, password, names, contact information, visibility in the global address list (`hideInGal`) or quota limit of the email account. When set, `checksum` must match the current checksum of the account, otherwise the update is rejected.

get.description: Returns the aliases of the platform with their target. Filter them by `alias`, `aliasTargetId`, `aliasOrganizationId` or `aliasOrganizationLabel`.

parameters.name: aliasOrganizationId
parameters.description: Filter by organization identifier of the aliases

parameters.name: aliasOrganizationLabel
parameters.description: Filter by organization label of the aliases

parameters.name: aliasTargetId
parameters.description: Filter by the targeted email account identifier

post.description: Creates an alias address from `alias` and the ID of its target in `targetId`. The alias domain and the target domain must be in the same organization.

value.message: The alias name is already used
The alias domain and target domain are not in the same organization
The alias domain name cannot be found
The alias target cannot be found
The alias domain is not in READY status
The alias target object is not in READY status

delete.description: Deletes the alias address. The alias, its domain and its target must be ready.

get.description: Returns the alias address, its domain and organization, and its target: an email account or a mailing list.

value.message: Multiple aliases were found with the requested ID

post.description: Checks the MX, SPF, DKIM and autodiscover DNS records of the domains listed in `domains`. Returns, for each domain, the status and errors of each test, the records found and the expected DNS configuration.

get.description: Returns the domains of the platform with their current state. Filter them by `organizationId`, `organizationLabel` or `domainName`.

post.description: Adds a domain to an organization from its `name` and `organizationId`. When the DNS zone is hosted by OVHcloud, `autoConfigureMX`, `autoConfigureSPF`, `autoConfigureDKIM` and `autoConfigureAutodiscover` configure the matching records automatically. Creation is asynchronous: follow `resourceStatus` and `currentTasks`.

delete.description: Deletes the domain from its organization.

get.description: Returns the domain, its organization, its account statistics per offer and the DNS configuration to apply: ownership, MX, SPF, DKIM and autodiscover.

value.message: The domain was not found with the provided criteria

put.description: Enables or disables DKIM with `dkimEnabled`, or moves the domain, with its email accounts, to another organization with `organizationId`. When set, `checksum` must match the current checksum of the domain, otherwise the update is rejected.

value.message: The domain was not found with the provided criteria
The checksum is invalid because the object has expired

get.description: Returns the organizations of the platform with their current state. Filter them by `organizationName`.

post.description: Creates an organization from its `name`, its `label` and an optional `description`. The label is a short name that must be unique on the platform. Creation is asynchronous: follow `resourceStatus` and `currentTasks`.

value.message: Label exceeds maximum length of {{.LABEL_MAX_LENGTH}} characters

delete.description: Deletes the organization. An organization still linked to domains cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns the name, label and description of the organization, its storage consumed and its account statistics per offer.

put.description: Updates the name, label or description of the organization. When set, `checksum` must match the current checksum of the organization, otherwise the update is rejected.

value.message: Label exceeds maximum length of {{.LABEL_MAX_LENGTH}} characters
The object is in an undesired status
The checksum is invalid because the object has expired

get.description: Returns the redirections of the platform with their current state. Filter them by `source`, `destination`, `domainId` or `organizationId`.

post.description: Creates a redirection from a `source` email address to a `destination` email address.

get.description: Returns the source and destination email addresses of the redirection, with its domain and organization.

value.message: The redirection was not found within your organization

post.description: Recomputes the quota usage (`quota.used` and `quotaRefreshedAt`) of every email account of the platform. The refresh runs asynchronously.
